name: Obsidian Starter Kit

variants.name: Essentials
variants.description: The complete vault, the online user guide and every future update

contents: **My own Obsidian vault**, packaged for you: structure, note types, templates, Bases, plugins, automation rules and an AI assistant system, all configured and documented
**Clearly defined note types** with structured properties, statuses and automation rules, managed by the OSK plugin, its CLI (`osk-cli`) and its `MCP` server
**40+ templates** that fill in the metadata and file each note where it belongs

**Finished work that files itself**: statuses stamp their dates, and done goals, plans, projects, tasks, activities and ideas move to the archive seven days later (change the delay or switch it off per note type)
**Quick Actions**: rows of buttons and one-click captures on your daily note, plus a side panel with every button
**A complete action system**: goals, plans, projects, tasks, activities and ideas linked across the hierarchy, with dependencies, Kanban boards and time budgets
**An ideal week for your activities**: a week grid with no dates on the `Kanban: Activities` board, where every active activity gets its recurring time blocks next to its weekly target
**A journaling system** with daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly and yearly notes that share one shape, powered by the `Journal Bases` plugin
**A knowledge workflow** that takes you from capture and literature notes to permanent notes
**People and meeting systems** with interaction tracking, decisions and actions
**Health and habit tracking** (mood, energy, sleep, exercise, nutrition) with the `Life Tracker` plugin
First-class `Obsidian Bases` support: database-like views for books, projects, contacts, time budgets and more
**An AI assistant system**: agents with memory, AI skills, panels, LLM Wikis and a Personal Identity System. `Claude Code` gets all of it; `Codex`, `Gemini CLI` and `GitHub Copilot` get part of it
**MCP servers pre-wired** for `Claude Code` and `Codex`, and a Claude Code setup that finds skills on demand instead of loading all of them up front
**Pre-configured plugins and settings**, including `Kanban Action Planner`, `K-Plex`, the `Knowii Community` plugin and `Time Machine` (so you can recover lost work)
**Visual thinking support** with Canvas and Excalidraw
**An online user guide**: foundations, systems, theory, step-by-step tutorials, reference docs and migration guides
